cohort: Nulliparous women aged 13-19 years with a singleton birth of 28 weeks or above, excluding those who were multigravida, had multiple pregnancies, were alcoholics, smokers, had any medical disorder, or had a strong family history of hypertension.
finding: Teenage pregnancies are associated with an increased risk of anemia (34.2%), pregnancy-induced hypertension (33.3%), preterm delivery (23.9%), cesarean section (33.33%), stillbirth (12.82%), and low birth weight (21.57%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 21.57% of live newborns.
